english.title: Solemnize a marriage in a place other than a place where banns may be published
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) knowingly and wilfully solemnized a marriage between **(..SPECIFY PARTIES TO THE MARRIAGE..) according to the rites of the Church of England in a place other than a church or other building in which banns of matrimony may be published, namely **(..SPECIFY PLACE..)
english.legislation: Contrary to section 75(1)(c) of the Marriage Act 1949.

investigatoraction.description: DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes: An offence under section 75(1)(c) of the Marriage Act 1949 is not committed where the marriage was a marriage by special licence or a marriage in pursuance of section 26(1)(dd) of the Marriage Act 1949.
